desc.zh: 用窗口排名找每位用户的第二次销售，并保留没有第二次销售的用户。
desc.en: Rank each seller’s sales to compare the second item while retaining users without a second sale.

complexity: O(m log m) time; O(m) intermediate space

concepts.name: Per-seller ranking
concepts.description: Partition orders by seller and number them by date.

concepts.name: Preserving missing matches
concepts.description: Start from Users and use a LEFT JOIN so missing second sales become no.
